workload.name: continuous motion
workload.generator: ffplay renders FFmpeg lavfi testsrc2 at native 1824x848 and 60 Hz in a fullscreen Wayland window. The browser only observes and decodes that native application.
workload.command: ffplay -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=1824x848:rate=60 -fs -autoexit (fixed owned process; no caller-supplied command)

topologyAtStart.ffmpegCommand: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel warning -nostdin -f rawvideo -pixel_format bgra -video_size 1280x720 -framerate 60 -i pipe:0 -an -c:v libx264 -preset superfast -tune zerolatency -profile:v high444 -level:v 5.2 -pix_fmt yuv444p -b:v 8000k -maxrate 16000k -bufsize 16000k -g 15 -keyint_min 15 -sc_threshold 0 -bf 0 -x264-params aud=1:repeat-headers=1:colorprim=bt709:transfer=iec61966-2-1:colormatrix=bt709:fullrange=on -vf scale=1280:720:out_color_matrix=bt709:out_range=pc -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc iec61966-2-1 -color_range pc -payload_type 96 -ssrc 1 -rtpflags skip_rtcp -f rtp rtp://127.0.0.1:39119?pkt_size=60000

recovery.explanation: The probe returns one synthetic decodeQueueSize value of 24 to the unchanged SDK queue-cap check. The SDK then invokes the native VideoDecoder.reset path; all reset, output, and draw observations are actual browser operations, and the recorded actual queue values are not rewritten.

observation.scope: One probe-only decodeQueueSize read is replaced with 24. The unchanged SDK makes the queue-cap decision and calls the real decoder reset; reset, output, and draw fields report actual browser operations.
observation.injectionLabel: injected queue-pressure observation (not actual decoder overload)

checks.name: one injected queue-pressure observation fired

actual.label: injected queue-pressure observation (not actual decoder overload)

checks.requirement: exactly one attempt; injected observation is 24 while the actual queue is below 24

checks.name: injection followed a same-generation keyframe on its first delta
checks.requirement: a plain keyframe, then its same-generation first plain delta, then the injected read

checks.name: production decoder reset ran exactly once
checks.requirement: one VideoDecoder.reset after the injected queue-cap read, with no earlier recovery-phase reset

checks.name: decoder produced output from the next keyframe
checks.requirement: next received keyframe and a later actual VideoDecoder output

checks.name: first post-reset draw was captured when observable
checks.requirement: an actual canvas draw after reset when CanvasRenderingContext2D.drawImage can be wrapped

checks.name: recovery observation finished within its bounded lifetime
checks.requirement: finished before 10000 ms with at most one attempt

browserTimings.scope: Browser timings share the window performance clock. Decoder stages and SDK draws are joined exactly by WebCodecs media timestamp. Native capture timestamps use a different clock and are retained without subtraction.

pipeline.scope: Video headers from this browser's stream, without payload. Missing capture sequences do not distinguish encoder replacement from transport or gateway loss.

monotonicFrameCounters.scope: Deltas span the first and last recorder samples, not the exact 30-second edges. They are strict session-monotonic counters; frames before the first sample or after the last sample are excluded.

checks.name: expected quality throughout recording
checks.requirement: 8000 kbps at 100% scale in every SDK sample

checks.name: no decoder resets during steady motion

cpu.scope: Whole-Sprite /proc/stat plus read-only per-process /proc samples. Per-process CPU uses one logical core as 100%. ffplay workload cost is separate from the gateway, streamd, encoder FFmpeg, and labwc.
